title: Nvidia designs the chips — but one company in Taiwan builds them

beats.narration: Nvidia designs the most valuable chips on Earth — but it doesn't manufacture a single one.
Its Blackwell processors are just blueprints until someone etches them into real silicon.
And that someone is one company, in Taiwan.
TSMC builds nearly every advanced AI chip in the world — for Nvidia, Apple, and AMD alike.
So when Nvidia's orders jump, TSMC's revenue climbs right behind it.
Its monthly sales recently rose more than 40% from a year earlier, driven by AI demand.
One company designs the future, another builds it. Follow for more market connections.
